links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to carpal tunnel syndrome patient questions versus recommended level
links.effect: Readability scores differed significantly between models; ChatGPT-4o was most readable and o1 most complex, but all models remained above the recommended level for the general population.
links.quote: Furthermore, the readability of all models remains above the recommended level for the general population.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, accuracy, and lexical diversity of various ChatGPT versions (GPT-4, GPT-4o, GPT-o1) answering common carpal tunnel syndrome questions without testing specific deployment safeguards.
